title: Accessible carousel with scroll snap
when: The user wants slides that move sideways with arrows, dots or swipe, such as featured products or a banner.
prompt:
Goal: A carousel built on CSS scroll snap, with labeled controls, a polite live region and no autoplay unless asked and pausable.
Steps:
1. <section aria-roledescription="carousel" aria-label="Featured">; each slide is <div role="group" aria-roledescription="slide" aria-label="2 of 5">.
2. The track uses overflow-x: auto and scroll-snap-type: x mandatory, so swipe and no JS scrolling work.
3. Previous and Next buttons call scrollBy with one slide width; dot buttons have aria-label Go to slide 3, the active one aria-current="true", tracked with IntersectionObserver.
4. A track wrapper with aria-live="polite" announces slide changes made by the buttons.
5. Autoplay only if asked: 7 s or more, a visible Pause button, pause on hover and focus, set aria-live to off while playing, never under prefers-reduced-motion.
Quality bar:
- Each slide works alone; key content is not only in slide 3.
- Controls are visible and 44 px.
- Scroll smoothing is off for reduced motion.
Pitfalls:
- Autoplay with no pause.
- Only dots, no Previous and Next.
- Cloned slides for looping that screen readers read twice.
Verify:
- [ ] Buttons have type and names.
- [ ] A polite live region exists.
- [ ] Swipe works by scroll snap.
- [ ] Reduced motion disables autoplay.
Output: Carousel markup, carousel.css and carousel.js.

examples.output: section carousel with five slide groups, scroll snap track, Previous and Next, dots with Go to slide n, no autoplay
